terra.problem: The family heads call Zelophehad their brother, but the text does not establish that they were his literal brothers.
The passage says the LORD commanded Moses to give the land by lot; it does not say the land had already been given out.
The command keeps inheritance within the tribe. Saying it must stay in the family line it was given to suggests a narrower restriction than the text gives.
